title: A pastor, a Tejano singer, and a slew of salmon and Sullivans walk into a midterm
gist: Paywalled teaser: with less than a week to the 2026 midterms, Democrats look good on nearly every national measure but key races remain neck and neck, including Texas candidates Bobby Pulido, James Talarico, and Gina Hinojosa.

insights.claim: With under a week until the 2026 midterm Election Day, Democrats are looking good by nearly every national measure.
insights.speaker: Halina Bennet
insights.so_what: Rising odds of a Democratic House/Senate shift affects policy and regulatory outlook for 2027.
insights.quote: With less than one week until Election Day, Democrats are looking good by nearly every national measure.

insights.claim: Despite favorable national indicators, Democrats remain wary because key 2026 midterm races are neck and neck.
insights.speaker: Halina Bennet
insights.so_what: Outcome uncertainty remains; control of chambers not locked in.

insights.claim: Texas Democrats Bobby Pulido (U.S. House), James Talarico (U.S. Senate), and Gina Hinojosa (governor) are campaigning together, including at a Voto Latino rally.
insights.speaker: Halina Bennet
insights.so_what: Texas competitiveness is a signal of the breadth of the Democratic wave.
